# Clovis Web Design

> Custom web design, Google Maps SEO, AI search optimization (ChatGPT, Gemini, Claude, Perplexity, Siri), and lead attribution for growth-minded businesses. Built and operated by Adam in Clovis, California.

## Overview
Clovis Web Design is an independent web engineering and search/AI marketing studio operated by Adam in Clovis, California, serving businesses in Fresno, Clovis, the Central Valley, and across the United States. Sites are hand-coded with modern web standards (Astro, React, Tailwind CSS) for sub-0.4-second mobile loading, 100/100 Google PageSpeed, Google Maps 3-Pack rankings, and AI answer engine citations. No WordPress templates, no page builders, zero monthly hostage fees, and 100% client asset ownership from day one.

## Four Core Services (Available Individually or Combined)
1. Custom Web Design & Engineering: https://cloviswebdesign.com/#who
   - Hand-coded static websites opening in under 0.4s on mobile, scoring 100/100 on Google PageSpeed, built to WCAG 2.1 AA accessibility, with optional full Spanish (/es/) and compliant intake routing.
   - Why it matters: Over half of mobile visitors abandon pages that take 3–4 seconds to load, and live AI search crawlers time out on slow templates before reading a single word.
2. Search Engine & Google Maps SEO: https://cloviswebdesign.com/services/local-seo-fresno/
   - Google Business Profile optimization, dedicated high-intent service and market pages, and review velocity systems to rank in the Google Maps 3-Pack and organic search results.
   - Why it matters: Captures ready-to-buy searchers at the top of Google without paying per click.
3. AI Search & Answer Optimization (GEO): https://cloviswebdesign.com/services/local-seo-fresno/#ai-search
   - Four-directory entity sync across Google Business Profile, Bing Places, Apple Business Connect, and Yelp, connected JSON-LD @graph schema, fact-dense answer blocks, and /llms.txt discovery files so ChatGPT, Google Gemini, Claude, Perplexity, and Apple Siri recommend the business.
   - Why it matters: AI assistants name only 1 to 3 businesses per query, and each AI checks a different directory before citing a company.
4. AI & Search Lead Attribution: https://cloviswebdesign.com/#check
   - Custom Google Analytics 4 (GA4) channel configuration isolating referrals from ChatGPT, Gemini, Claude, and Perplexity alongside phone call, SMS, and form conversion tracking.
   - Why it matters: Default analytics buries AI referrals inside generic traffic; clear attribution proves marketing ROI.

## Engagement Models
- Custom Website Build (Custom Scoped · One-time project):
  - Hand-coded custom website (<0.4s mobile load, 100/100 PageSpeed).
  - Working phone preview before you pay anything ($0 if you don't approve the preview).
  - Done-for-you copywriting from a 15-minute discovery call.
  - Tap-to-call, SMS, form, and Google Search tracking.
  - 90 days of free fixes after launch and 100% client ownership of code, domain, and hosting.
- Search & AI Visibility Setup (Standalone Overhaul or Add-On):
  - Four-directory profile sync across Google Maps, Bing Places, Apple Business Connect, and Yelp.
  - Connected LocalBusiness, Service, and FAQPage JSON-LD structured data.
  - Fact-dense answer architecture written for ChatGPT, Gemini, and Claude extraction.
  - Machine-readable /llms.txt and AI agent discovery files, plus custom GA4 AI referral and call tracking.
- Ongoing Search & AI Growth (Monthly Retainer · Month-to-Month):
  - New high-intent service, product, and market pages each month.
  - Ongoing Google Maps, ChatGPT, Gemini, and Claude citation and review growth.
  - Monthly lead attribution and ROI reporting, plus same-day text-me website updates. Cancel anytime with one text.

- Big Bros Dumpster Rentals: https://cloviswebdesign.com/case-studies/dumpster-rental-fresno/

  - Result: Ranked #1 on Google for "dumpster rental Fresno", added 4 trucks to keep up with calls.
  - Verified Quote: "The national brokers were getting the calls and taking a cut of every rental. Since Adam redid our site, contractors and homeowners in Fresno and Clovis just text us straight. We had to buy 4 more trucks to keep up." — William Maldonado Ramirez, Co-Owner & Head of Operations.
- Kidney Specialist Inc.: https://cloviswebdesign.com/case-studies/kidney-specialist-fresno/
  - Trade: Nephrology medical practice in Madera & Fresno, CA.
  - Result: Zero patient data collected online, 100/100 Google PageSpeed, doctor referrals up 40% by Dr. Masood's count.
  - Verified Quote: "HIPAA was my big worry. Most web people I talked to didn't really know what it meant for a website. Adam did. Our site doesn't collect any patient information, it looks professional, and referrals from other doctors are up more than 40%." — Dr. Sheikh Mohammad Masood, MD, Founding President & Medical Director.

## Core Guarantees & Principles
1. Phone Preview Guarantee: For website builds, Adam builds a working preview on your phone before you pay a dollar. If you don't love it, you owe nothing.
2. ROI Honesty: Every engagement is scoped to the return it can generate. If Adam doesn't see a clear way for the work to pay for itself, he says so on the first call.
3. Complete Independence: Clients own the domain, source code, and analytics accounts from day one. Zero agency lock-in.
